description: ⚠️ Fold other documents into one document as its versions: each document in merge_documents stops existing as a separate document and becomes a version of root_document_id. Use it when the same paper arrived twice (e.g. a scan and a later emailed copy). Runs asynchronously.

confirm.description: Must be true — merged documents no longer exist as separate documents

merge_documents.description: Documents to turn into versions of the root

root_document_id.description: The document that keeps existing and receives the versions

name: merge_documents_as_versions
